T: Roll up. Roll up. Dinner is served.
D: A dreamer from nothing builds a dazzling circus show in 1800s New York.
P: Serve the snacks when the ringmaster opens the show.
S: the smallest star of the show

Peanuts in the shell roasted at 180C for 20 minutes, tossed hot with salt and a little smoked paprika, served in paper cones. Spread 400g peanuts in the shell on a tray and roast at 180C for 20 minutes. Toss hot with flaky salt and a little smoked paprika. Roll paper into cones and fill them up.
the crowd pouring into the tent
Popcorn tossed in a brown sugar and butter caramel with a pinch of bicarb and salt, baked at 120C for 45 minutes, stirred every 15.

Crisp green apples on sticks dipped in a glassy red toffee, half rolled in crushed salted peanuts before it sets. Wash and dry 8 small green apples and push a stick into each. Boil 400g caster sugar, 150ml water, 2 tbsp golden syrup and 1 tsp vinegar to 150C without stirring, then add red food colouring. Tip the pan and dip each apple, twisting, then roll the bottom in 60g crushed salted peanuts and set on baking paper for 15 minutes.
M: the Swedish Nightingale's first American show

Beef sirloin roasted at 200C to 52C, rested, carved, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and a red wine gravy. Roast a 1.5kg sirloin at 200C until 52C inside and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C for 20 minutes. Reduce 200ml red wine with the pan juices for gravy.
Jenny Lind, the Swedish singer on her American tour

Pork and beef meatballs with allspice, browned in butter and simmered in a creamy brown gravy, with buttery mash, lingonberry jam and quick pickled cucumber. Mix 400g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 50g breadcrumbs soaked in 80ml milk, 1 egg, half a teaspoon of allspice and salt. Roll 28 balls and brown in butter. Stir 2 tbsp flour into the pan, whisk in 400ml beef stock, 100ml cream and 1 tsp soy, add the meatballs and simmer 10 minutes. Toss sliced cucumber in vinegar, sugar and dill. Serve with mash and lingonberry jam.
W: Red velvet layer cake baked at 175C, layered and covered in cream cheese frosting, gold sprinkles on top.
K: the bar where the partnership is agreed

A sugar cube soaked in bitters in the bottom of a coupe, a splash of cognac, topped with cold champagne and a twist of lemon. Put a sugar cube in each of 4 coupes and soak with 2 dashes of aromatic bitters. Add 15ml cognac to each, then slowly top with cold champagne. Twist a strip of lemon peel over and drop it in. Use sparkling apple juice and a dash of bitters for the younger crowd.

w.how: Beat 125g butter and 250g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, 250ml buttermilk and red colouring. Bake in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Layer and cover with 250g cream cheese beaten with 250g icing sugar. Add gold sprinkles.
